design.history_resolution_boundary: resolution_date < current forecast_due_date; same-day resolutions excluded
design.imputation_policy: exclude a scored Polymarket row only when every matched original ForecastBench source forecast has imputed=true
design.leakage_control: current-date outcomes are never used for model selection or prediction; they are used only for current-date scoring
design.selection: at each forecast date, retain a model only if its historical BI gap versus Polymarket is <= 2.0 on at least 50 common targets resolved strictly before that date
